```yaml
name: Infra Auto‑Remediation

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check_rate_limit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      skip: ${{ steps.rate_limit.outputs.skip }}
    steps:
      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Check rate limit
        id: rate_limit
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          now=$(date +%s)

          # Get workflow ID
          workflow_id=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/workflows/infra-auto-remediation.yml" | jq -r '.id')

          # Get recent completed runs
          runs=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/workflows/$workflow_id/runs?status=completed&per_page=100")

          # Count runs in the last hour
          count=$(echo "$runs" | jq '[.workflow_runs[] | select(.created_at >= (now - 3600 | todate))] | length')

          # Get the timestamp of the most recent run
          last_run=$(echo "$runs" | jq -r '.workflow_runs[0].created_at // empty')
          if [ -n "$last_run" ]; then
            last_ts=$(date -d "$last_run" +%s)
            diff=$((now - last_ts))
          else
            diff=999999
          fi

          if (( diff < 300 )); then
            echo "Skipping due to 5‑minute cooldown"
            skip=true
          elif (( count >= 10 )); then
            echo "Skipping due to 10‑hour cap"
            skip=true
          else
            skip=false
          fi

          echo "skip=$skip" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create needs‑human issue if skipped
        if: steps.rate_limit.outputs.skip == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const title = 'Auto‑remediation needs human intervention';
            const body = 'Auto‑remediation was skipped due to rate limiting. Please investigate manually.';
            const issue = await github.issues.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title,
              body
            });
            console.log(`Created issue #${issue.data.number}`);

  investigate:
    needs: check_rate_limit
    if: needs.check_rate_limit.outputs.skip == 'false'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Run investigation script
        id: investigate
        run: |
          echo "Investigating P1 alerts..."
          # Placeholder for real investigation logic
          findings="Redis memory high, PostgreSQL connection issues"
          echo "Findings: $findings"
          echo "findings=$findings" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Post findings to Discord
        uses: Ilshidur/action-discord@v1
        with:
          webhook_url: ${{ secrets.DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          content: |
            Auto‑remediation findings:
            ${{ steps.investigate.outputs.findings }}

      - name: Create GitHub issue with findings
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const title = 'Auto‑remediation findings';
            const body = `Auto‑remediation investigation results:\n\n${process.env.FINDINGS}`;
            const issue = await github.issues.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title,
              body
            });
            console.log(`Created issue #${issue.data.number}`);
        env:
          FINDINGS: ${{ steps.investigate.outputs.findings }}
```
